_comment: Starter cards for the Enhancement board. Loaded once by manage_enhancement_ideas.seed_ideas_if_empty() on the first start of a fresh board, mirroring the Learning screen's seed_topics_if_empty pattern. Tracks the project's planned work (see PLANNED_WORK.md). A re-run never overwrites; deleting a card does not bring it back.

ideas.title: Integrate observability across every tab
ideas.note: P1. On each tab (Finance, Learning, Enhancement, Model, Main Menu) replace one existing block with an observability feature - live health, request/latency, error feed, or a trace view for that screen. Each block reads its own screen's data directly (no shared module).

ideas.title: Remove Shared_By_All_Agents and Shared_By_All_Screens entirely
ideas.note: P2. End state: both directories gone. Single-caller shared files get inlined into their caller and deleted; multi-caller files get copied into each caller, then deleted. App must keep booting after each file. Heavy pieces: read_and_write_numbers.py, add_and_search_the_knowledge_base.py, trace_every_action.py, the_lease_board.py, read_screen_settings.py.

ideas.title: Design the Enhancement tab (React 19 / Tailwind / Next.js)
ideas.note: P3. Build the Enhancement tab UI and structure to show PLANNED_WORK.md items as cards plus any data items flagged for follow-up. Card = title, area, status, priority, detail. Replaces the current Python/FastAPI ideas board frontend and, per the stack rule, its backend.

ideas.title: Migrate backends from Python/FastAPI to Node.js + Express
ideas.note: P4. One screen at a time (Main Menu, Finance, Learning, Enhancement), keeping ports and the plain-page fallback behaviour.

ideas.title: Finish Anime removal in the Next.js and Svelte Main Menu UIs
ideas.note: P5. The plain HTML/JS Main Menu is clean. Give the framework variants a full pass for layout gaps left by removing the Anime card.

ideas.title: Replace the example Learning seeds
ideas.note: P6. manage_study_topics.py, seed_the_week_plans.py and manage_recall_cards.py ship generic example content. Swap in a real plan, or load seeds from the private (Google Drive) layer once it lands.

ideas.title: Google Drive private storage layer
ideas.note: P7. immediate_plan.md Phase 5: one storage seam -> adopted Node.js Google Drive MCP server (app is the MCP client) -> RAG/smart-retrieval extending add_and_search_the_knowledge_base.py. Goal: nothing personal on local disk.
